name: gmail-multi
description: Search, read, and draft across SEVERAL Gmail accounts at once — the managed Gmail connector binds to one account; this one covers them all in a single query, tags every result with its mailbox, fetches attachments, and creates drafts it structurally cannot send. Standalone: configure accounts with its own /gmail-multi:accounts command; app passwords stay in the OS credential store and are never seen by Claude. Use it whenever mail spans more than one Google account.

metadata.versioningPolicy: Explicit releases; minor per behaviour change, patch per fix. Bump before any sync or push — an unbumped change ships nothing and looks like a broken install.
metadata.provides: MCP server gmail-multi (5 gmail_* tools). Contracts: adr-004-gmail-connector-extraction.md
